name: Spark CPU site pour
intent: Walk a regular operator through eight micro-tasks inside Zoth Studio Pour, then stamp a Zoth-vibe static site.
scope: Use the Pour tab (8484#pour) or http://127.0.0.1:8765/
One model call per suggestion step. Never one-shot a whole site.
The kit writes files. The model only names, lines, and offers.
Keep Zoth Studio as the harness. Spark is the small local brain.

steps.title: Write the brief
steps.prompt: Ask the local model for a site brief JSON (brand, headline, lede, three works, close). No URLs. No markdown.

steps.title: Stamp the kit
steps.prompt: Run python3 /home/neo/rust-website/scripts/pour.py "<brief>" and confirm sites/<slug>/index.html exists.

steps.title: Preview
steps.prompt: Open http://127.0.0.1:8765/preview/<slug>/ or the Spark UI at http://127.0.0.1:8765/
